display_name: The whole Work Injury Compensation Act 2019 (ss 1-83, Part 3A, First to Sixth Schedules) as eight goals: coverage, liability, amount, payment, claim process, damages, insurance, offences
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 06 Oct 2026 (2020 Revised Edition, with Act 30 of 2024, S 694/2025 and S 751/2025): ss 1-83 including ss 11A, 34A-34P, 35A-35B, 47A-47I, and the First to Sixth Schedules, combined into eight goal-level conclusions. The law is stated for accidents from 1 January 2025; earlier accidents refuse (s 83(1) for those before 1 September 2020; the pre-Platform Workers Act text for the rest is not in the source). Both sets of First/Fifth Schedule floors and caps (before and from 1 November 2025) are encoded. Inert (carried as text): powers, procedure and definitions with nothing to compute, listed in wica-administration.l4. Inputs: discretions, the work stage, the daily rate of AME, and everything prescribed by regulations. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act; the regulations are outside the source.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-06 (tests-independent.l4; expectations written from the source before the encoding was read, in independent-expectations.md); it found five encoding errors, all fixed, and its triage is in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md and NOTES.md section 9. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: A platform worker's accident outside Singapore: the Act does not say (s 9 is about employees); REFUSE.
forks.F2: s 10(5): the limitation period ends on the same calendar date N months after the worker ceased in the occupation.
forks.F3: s 11(2) with no incapacity: the date of death; certification alone when there is no death; REFUSE with neither.
forks.F4: First Schedule para 4: the daily rate of AME for temporary incapacity is an input.
forks.F5: First Schedule para 4(1)(c): the first 14 days are one count shared by medical leave and light duties.
forks.F6: No Interpretation Act holiday shift is applied to deadlines.
forks.F7: Fourth Schedule Note 2: the hand parts in one call are one hand; item 2 (both hands) is not a hand part.
forks.F8: s 18(2)(c)-(e): a Commissioner's direction prevails, then death, then incapacity.
forks.F9: s 35A(4): equal AMEs fall to the Commissioner's processing under (c).
forks.F10: Fifth Schedule para 5(1)(b) 'per employee' read as per platform worker.
forks.F11: s 3(3), s 34J: an illegal contract is reported as not covered; the saving is a discretion.
forks.F12: s 83(1) for a disease: the s 11(2) date of accident, or the date contracted where no s 11(2) date exists yet.
